app_tagline: Offline, private scam checker for India
input_placeholder: Paste SMS, WhatsApp message, or notice here...
target_sub: Isolate and analyze an individual link, phone number, or UPI ID.
emergency_sub: Take these actions immediately to freeze fund transfers and prevent further loss:
emergency_step1_title: 1. Immediately Call Your Bank & Freeze Cards
emergency_step1_desc: Immediately request freezing of Net Banking, UPI IDs, and ATM debit cards.
history_sub: Stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB. Zero external network transfer.
footer_disclaimer: Scam Shield is an automated offline heuristic checker designed for guidance. It is not a legal guarantee. In case of financial fraud, dial 1930 immediately.
family_card_sub: Share this verified alert to family WhatsApp groups.
family_card_rule_upi: Never enter UPI PIN to receive money.
family_card_rule_arrest: Police never conducts 'Digital Arrest' over video call.
family_card_rule_helpline: In case of loss, call 1930 immediately.
next_steps: What you should do in next 5 minutes:

reasons.electricity_threat: Threatens electricity power cut at night to create panic.
reasons.fake_kyc: Urges immediate KYC or PAN update through unauthorized channels.
reasons.upi_collect_fraud: Requests entering UPI PIN to receive money (You never need a PIN to receive).
reasons.digital_arrest: Claims police/CBI/customs arrest over video call (Digital Arrest is 100% fake).
reasons.challan_fraud: Fake traffic challan notification designed to download malicious APK files.
reasons.sim_block_threat: Threatens imminent SIM or phone line disconnection impersonating TRAI or DoT.
reasons.courier_customs: Demands fees for a detained parcel or customs clearance.
reasons.job_task_scam: Offers unrealistic daily income for liking videos or rating maps.
reasons.lottery_prize: Claims prize money or lottery win requiring upfront clearance fees.
reasons.loan_app_risk: Promotes unauthorized instant loan apps through direct APK downloads.
reasons.investment_fraud: Promises guaranteed high returns via private WhatsApp or Telegram channels.
reasons.fake_scheme: Fake government scheme or free gift offer used for data harvesting.
reasons.urgency_pressure: Uses extreme artificial urgency or countdown deadlines to force hasty decisions.
reasons.remote_access_risk: Asks you to install remote access apps (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) to hijack your device.
reasons.suspicious_link: Contains a suspicious URL, shortener, or dangerous file extension.
reasons.credential_harvesting: Requests sensitive personal credentials (SSN, Aadhaar, PAN, or identity documents).
reasons.advance_fee: Demands upfront processing fees or deposits to release prize money.
reasons.genuine_warning: Contains official bank safety markers ('Do not share OTP').
reasons.genuine_domain: Points to an authenticated government (.gov.in) or official banking domain.
reasons.genuine_txn: Matches standard banking debited/credited transaction notification formats.
reasons.link_shortener: Uses a link shortener (e.g., bit.ly) to hide destination website.
reasons.link_ip_address: Direct IP link used instead of a registered domain.
reasons.link_risky_tld: Uses a high-risk domain extension (.xyz, .top, etc.).
reasons.link_apk_download: Directly downloads an APK file to your phone.
reasons.link_brand_impersonation: Impersonates a bank or trusted service.
reasons.upi_impersonation_handle: UPI ID contains suspicious fraud words ('refund', 'support').
reasons.upi_pin_warning: Warning: You never enter your PIN to receive money.
reasons.phone_personal_claiming_official: Personal 10-digit mobile number claiming to be an official bank.
reasons.phone_foreign_origin: Foreign phone number originating outside India.

electricity_disconnection: Do not call the phone number given in the message.
Check your actual bill on your electricity provider's official app or portal.
Electricity departments never disconnect power at night via SMS.
fake_kyc: Never click on links claiming to be from your bank.
Visit your nearest bank branch or use the official mobile banking app.
Banks never ask for passwords or OTP over SMS.
upi_collect: Remember: You never enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
Decline any collect requests immediately on PhonePe or GPay.
Call 1930 immediately if money was deducted.
digital_arrest: Digital arrest is completely fake. Police never arrest anyone over video calls.
Do not transfer money to any safe verification account.
job_task: Legitimate companies never pay thousands daily just for liking videos.
Never pay any prepaid task investment or registration fee.
Exit and block the recruiter group immediately.
lottery_prize: You cannot win a lottery you never entered.
Never pay upfront processing fees or taxes.
default_safe: Always verify the sender before sharing any details.
